spec.niche: Swiss typographic research archive documenting 20th century poster design, grid systems, and Helvetica history for designers and academics

design_system.layout_style: strict 12-column grid with visible baseline alignment, generous whitespace, flush-left ragged-right text blocks, asymmetric placements anchored to grid, oversized numerals as section markers
design_system.mood: rigorous, intellectual, archival, precise, mid-century Swiss design school

page_descriptions.startseite: Fixed left sidebar (240px) with vertical logo lockup 'ATP / 1957→' and navigation list in 14px Helvetica. Main area opens with an oversized headline flush-left: 'Archiv für Typografische Praxis — Studien zur Schweizer Gestaltung 1950–1985.' below a thin 1px black rule. Right of headline: small meta block with current date, edition number ('Ausgabe 47'), and item count ('3.412 Objekte'). Below: 12-column grid showing 4 featured archive objects (poster scans) with caption blocks underneath each (designer / year / medium / inventory number). Mid-page editorial pull quote in 48px set across 8 columns: 'Die Form folgt der Funktion, aber das Raster folgt der Idee.' Footer band lists three latest essays with date stamps. All headings, labels, and buttons in German ('Sammlung durchsuchen', 'Aktuelle Essays', 'Newsletter abonnieren').
page_descriptions.sammlung: Sidebar persists. Top of main area: filter bar with flush-left chips ('Plakat', 'Buchgestaltung', 'Signaletik', 'Schriftmuster', 'Periode 1950–60', 'Periode 1960–70'). Below: dense 4-column grid of archive objects, each card is a white tile with the scan, inventory number top-right in red monospace-feel, designer name bold, year, medium. Sort dropdown top-right ('sortieren nach: Jahr ↓'). Pagination bottom with numbered pages and result count ('Zeige 1–48 von 3.412').
page_descriptions.objekt-detail: Two-column split: left 7 columns show the full archive scan on light grey backdrop with thin black frame; right 5 columns hold a structured data table — Titel, Gestalter:in, Jahr, Auftraggeber, Druckverfahren, Format, Inventarnr., Provenienz, Standort. Below table: long-form curatorial note (3 paragraphs) in 16px. Further down: 'Verwandte Objekte' row of 4 thumbnails. Bottom: citation block in light grey panel with copyable BibTeX-style reference.
page_descriptions.essays: Editorial index page. Headline 'Essays & Forschung' flush-left. Below: list view (not grid) with each essay as a row spanning 12 columns — left 2 cols: large issue number in red (e.g. '№ 042'), middle 7 cols: title in 32px + dek + author + reading time, right 3 cols: thumbnail. Thin black rules between rows. Filter by Thema (Raster, Schrift, Geschichte, Praxis) as horizontal tabs.
page_descriptions.essay-detail: Long-form text-heavy page. Centered measure ~640px for body, but article opens full-width with hero scan and metadata bar (Autor:in / Datum / Lesedauer / Kategorie). Drop cap in red at first paragraph. Multi-column (2-col) sections for dense passages. Pull quotes flush-left, oversized 36px with red left border. Footnotes numbered, listed at article end. Sidebar (sticky, right side, narrow) shows table of contents with current section highlighted. End of essay: author bio card + 'Weiterlesen' with two related essays.
page_descriptions.raster-system: Interactive documentation page explaining the archive's own grid methodology. Top: schematic diagram of a 12-column grid with measurements labeled. Below: alternating text-and-diagram sections demonstrating column ratios, baseline grid, modular scale. Code-style blocks (in light grey panels) show CSS grid declarations. Three-column comparison of historical Swiss grids (Müller-Brockmann, Hofmann, Ruder) with annotated reproductions.
page_descriptions.uber-uns: Mission statement set as a single 800px-wide text column, opening with a manifesto-style numbered list (01–07) of archival principles. Below: team section — flush-left grid of 6 team members, each with B&W portrait, name in bold, role, two-line bio. Further: institutional timeline 1957→2024 as a horizontal scrolling band with year markers and milestone notes. Partner institutions logos in a clean row at bottom.
page_descriptions.kontakt: Two-column layout. Left 5 columns: contact form with German labels (Name, E-Mail, Anfrage-Art dropdown [Forschungszugang / Reproduktion / Presse / Spende], Nachricht), submit button in red 'Anfrage senden'. Right 7 columns: structured info blocks — Besucheradresse (Zürich), Öffnungszeiten as a data table by weekday, Forschungslesesaal hours, telephone, email. Below: simple map placeholder with thin black border.

special_elements: permanent left sidebar navigation with vertical brand lockup and tight 14px nav links
visible 12-column grid with hairline 1px black rules separating major sections
oversized red issue/section numerals as recurring typographic anchors
inventory numbers and metadata in tabular flush-right alignment throughout
strict baseline grid maintained across all text blocks, no rounded corners anywhere
spec.responsive_notes: Desktop (≥1200px): full 12-column grid with persistent 240px left sidebar. Tablet (768–1199px): sidebar collapses to a top horizontal bar with hamburger toggle revealing the drawer; grid reduces to 8 columns; archive cards 3-per-row; two-column splits become 60/40. Mobile (<768px): sidebar fully hidden behind hamburger icon top-left, drawer slides in from left covering 80% viewport; all grids collapse to single column; data tables reflow into stacked label/value pairs; pull quotes remain oversized but reduce to 28px; baseline grid preserved, generous whitespace maintained — no decorative softening, the Swiss rigor stays intact at every viewport.
